This has always posed a moral quandary for me. I am an IVF baby, born to a devout Catholic mother. She struggled with infertility for almost twenty years before she received a dream saying that she would have a baby girl. The very next day she decided to contact an IVF clinic. I was baptized Catholic and confirmed Catholic, and while I recognize the immorality of disposing of unused embryos (which did not happen in the case of my family), I cannot in good moral conscience say that IVF is wrong. I would not be here to dedicate my life to Jesus if not for IVF and I thank God every day that He has allowed us the technology to help men and women who have been struggling with infertility with seemingly no other options. God is all powerful and God is Lord. If my existence was against his will the, I would not exist. I say that we start accepting IVF while pushing for greater ethical guidelines in IVF clinics.
